name: Code Review
description: Review code, a change or a GitHub pull request: findings by severity, each with its file and line and a fix; a pull request review is posted only when you ask.
abilities: Works through a checklist: correctness, security, data, performance, maintainability
Ranks findings by severity and points to the line
Runs the tests in your sandbox when it can
Reads the pull request's description, files and whole diff, page by page
Learns the repository's conventions from its contributing guide, linter settings and neighbouring code
Writes one review with findings by severity, each pointing to the file and line, with a fix
permissions: Reads code you paste or files in your workspace
Uses the GitHub plugin, which you install from the Store: reads pull requests, and posts the review as one comment only when you ask and approve it

changes.notes: Merged with Pull Request Review, which is part of this skill now.
